text_block_list.text:
I brought Daring Tact to a shrine to pray, 
since she had been feeling out of sorts, 
but—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Yes, this should do nicely.

Right in front of her as she said that was 
a spread 
of fresh mountain produce and river fish.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: I gathered them from the nearby mountains!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The fish was caught in my trap just this 
morning, 
so it's as fresh as can be.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, and of course it was from a river 
where 
fishing gear is permitted, to be clear.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I picked the wild herbs and fruit along 
the way, too.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
While retrieving the fish, I was able to 
prepare 
a truly wonderful offering!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Huh? Was it perhaps not enough?
choice_data_list:
No, it's just... why go to all that 
trouble?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ? Well...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
When making a prayer or expressing 
gratitude, 
isn't it only natural to show the utmost 
respect?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Our lives are sustained by the bounties 
we receive from nature.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That is why returning a portion of those 
blessings 
is how we convey our daily gratitude and 
prayers.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
By doing so, the blessings circulate, 
returning to us as our own strength.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
This endless cycle is what it truly means 
to "live" within nature—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It is an important belief taught to me 
by the people back in my hometown.

text_block_list.name: Shrine Priest
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha, what unique offerings. I shall 
make sure 
they are placed reverently before the 
altar.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I pray for the continued prosperity of 
this shrine. 
Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: How do you feel right now?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I see... Hehe. 
I feel the exact same way.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I often think that giving a gift to 
another 
is also something we do for ourselves.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Close your eyes, and listen closely. 
From the very depths of your heart...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Can you hear it whispering "thank you"?

Wrapped in a warm, gentle feeling, 
Daring Tact seemed to have recovered her 
good condition.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I see. 
That is wonderful—

text_block_list.name: Shrine Priest
text_block_list.text:
Aaaah! 
Shoo, get away from there!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh no...! 
A crow is targeting the offerings...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... I suppose this, too, is the harsh 
providence of nature...

The offerings never reached their 
destination, 
and Daring Tact remained out of sorts.
